subject: After-action packet & SIG follow-up for Nov 29 service disruption
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alice Gordon <alice.gordon@argos-fin.com>, security@argos-fin.com
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Nov 29 outage — immediate summary and request for compliance artifacts

Alice / Argos security team —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier. Quick summary from Redwood: we observed elevated 5xx rates in the inference fleet starting ~2026-11-29T08:42Z that caused degraded responses for a subset of requests to your dedicated capacity pool. The root cause we’re tracking is a cascading resource contention triggered by a driver update on a small subset of nodes; we isolated the hosts and applied a rollback at ~08:56Z which restored normal throughput.

Immediate actions we took:
- Isolated 8 affected GPU nodes and removed from routing by 08:50Z.
- Rolled back driver update to previous validated kernel at 08:56Z.
- Replayed prefix cache warmup and validated key space consistency by 09:05Z.
- Kept enhanced tracing (token-level traces + kernel telemetry) enabled for 72h.

What we can provide to Argos security/compliance today:
- Compressed forensic export (request logs, kernel traces, telemetry) — see attachment stub.
- Draft postmortem (initial) and a completed SIG questionnaire focused on controls that mattered for this event.
- A redacted S3 access log extract and KMS audit timeline for the affected hostname group.

Requests from your side to help us finish the after-action packet:
1) Which specific evidence fields do your SOC 2 / TIG SIG reviewers need redacted vs full? (IPs, token hashes, customer identifiers).
2) Do you require a signed statement or attestation before we share full forensic archives?
3) Preferred secure transfer method (ShareFile, SFTP, Azure Blob SAS) and an inbox for large archives.

I’m attaching a short checklist and an initial payload (argos_nov29_forensics_log.tar.gz) to accelerate your triage. We’ll hold anything beyond that until we have redaction guidance or a legal hold.

Thanks — I’ll keep the channel open and can jump on a call if you prefer a walkthrough.

—
Naomi Feldman
Senior Security Liaison, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachment: argos_nov29_forensics_log.tar.gz (archive, 420MB)

From: Alice Gordon <alice.gordon@argos-fin.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, security@argos-fin.com
Cc: legal@argos-fin.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 10:05:33 -0800
Subject: Re: Nov 29 outage — immediate summary and request for compliance artifacts

Naomi — thanks for the rapid update and for the artifact. A few quick asks from Argos compliance: 

- Our SOC 2 reviewers will need the S3 access log slices and KMS event timeline covering 08:30Z–09:30Z in full (we can accept redaction of customer identifiers but need IPs and KMS key IDs).
- For the SIG spreadsheet, please mark controls related to change management and deployment gating; we’ll correlate to our internal change tickets.
- Regarding transfer: we prefer ShareFile for large archives; please send via secure link to security@argos-fin.com (IT will whitelist the sender).
- Legal requests confirmation that Redwood will redact any customer PII before cross-account transfer and provide an attestation that no exfil occurred.

Can you also provide an ETA for the postmortem draft and the completed SIG answers? Our audit window closes next Friday and we need these items before 2026-12-10 to avoid escalation.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—
Alice Gordon
Director, Information Security
Argos Financial
alice.gordon@argos-fin.com

Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 15:22:10 -0800
Subject: Postmortem draft + SIG answers — request for acceptance and redaction guidance

Alice / Argos team —

Per your request, attached are: postmortem-draft-v1.pdf and sig-questionnaire-completed.xlsx. Key notes in this draft:
- Timeline (UTC): detection 2026-11-29T08:42 -> isolation 08:50 -> rollback 08:56 -> normal service 09:05.
- Root cause: driver rollback created transient kernel-level memory alignment issue on a subset of hardware; change management gaps called out for a canary gating step.
- Mitigations: stricter canary policy, automated health gates, expanded preflight on driver variants.

We redacted customer identifiers in the postmortem draft but left host IPs and KMS key IDs unredacted per your earlier note. The SIG spreadsheet includes rationale for each control answer and references the ticket IDs for our internal change request (CHG-5843).

For transfer of the forensic archive we propose: ShareFile link -> password-protected -> one-time download token -> expiry 7 days. Link will be shared to security@argos-fin.com once legal confirms. We will not release the full archive until we receive explicit written acceptance from Argos legal that the redaction level is acceptable.

Next steps we need from Argos:
- Confirm redaction acceptance (IPs + KMS IDs OK; if you also need raw token traces we will need additional attestation).
- Confirm ShareFile is acceptable and provide SFTP as fallback.
- Confirm whether auditors need signed attestation or if an email thread is sufficient.

If helpful, we can schedule a 30m walkthrough of the artifacts and timeline — I’m available Mon/Tue mornings PT.

Thanks,
—
Naomi Feldman
Senior Security Liaison, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Attachment: postmortem-draft-v1.pdf, sig-questionnaire-completed.xlsx

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Postmortem draft + SIG answers — request for acceptance and redaction guidance

Naomi / Rishi — quick internal note before we push the ShareFile link:

- I completed the SIG spreadsheet updates and added control references for CHG gating and canary rollout (file attached in thread).
- Legal has requested automated redaction of full token traces (we will produce token hash aggregates instead of raw tokens) — that’s compatible with Argos ask but needs their confirmation.
- I will create the ShareFile transfer this afternoon and send a one-time link to security@argos-fin.com with an expiry of 72 hours. If Argos requests a longer window we’ll need a signed Data Transfer Agreement addendum.

Action items assigned:
- Stephanie: create ShareFile transfer + password and notify Argos (ETA EOD 2026-12-05).
- Rishi: prepare KMS audit timeline extract and confirm key IDs (ETA 2026-12-05 14:00 PT).
- Naomi: schedule a walkthrough if Argos wants; otherwise get their written acceptance of redaction level.
